subject: [hw] DONE IK rev 3
body:
Rev 3 = more host coverage only; the relay and the 0299 patch are unchanged (0299 sha256 a8d9b914...4a79, relay 74202691...3b19, K01 b57f87f9...aa98, K02 71f654e7...7eab).

Added 1000 deterministic pseudo-random ioctls to test_ik/t_relay.c: every command number (including unknown ones), both minors, random bytes up to 1200, random client ids, bad user addresses, random timeouts; the argument buffer is a union of all ioctl types because the kernel sizes `data` from the command's _IOC size field. Only documented errnos came back, and ASan+UBSan, -O2 and TSan are all clean. (The first fuzz version was wrong in the harness - it passed a 24-byte rwvc_msg for RWVC_INFO; ASan caught the test bug immediately. Fixed in the harness, not worked around in the relay.)

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh: N2TEST IK PASS 4325/4325
(1441 checks in each of the three configurations + the 0299 make_patch/compile checks).
bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/compile_check.sh: KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown.
Also verified the real build order end to end: pristine xnu-stage-backup-pre-p15 + 0085/0086/0087 + q10hq S= + 0296/0298/0299 (103 patches) applies with no rejects and compiles sweet_touch.c to 1,308,792 bytes, 0 errors. Details in kern/INTEGRATION.md and dsh-state/workers/IK/STATUS.md. Not-done list unchanged.
